# Bid the posts, the shade, and the height.

> Price a residential pergola or patio cover from the posts a square-foot special cannot see, the shade layer, the height, and the attached ledger — plus walk-away price and proposed-price margin check.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
